money.name: Moneys
money.about: A run's Moneys: wild prizes and trainers. Pays for healing and run shops; turns into Research when the run ends.

capital.name: Research
capital.about: What a run brings home. Spent on the Lab's unlock board.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.about: The building material. A little for every place a run reaches; spent at the ranch.

seals.name: Audit Seals
seals.about: Rare: one for beating a run's boss. Spent at the airship.
